BacktestTimestamp.description: UTC with Z and at most microsecond precision; local offsets and naive values are rejected.

BacktestDecimal.description: Exact finite Decimal string; no exponent, whitespace or JSON number. Precision 38, ROUND_HALF_EVEN; USD scale 8 and return scale 12. Semantic precision and rounding are validated by the domain.

BacktestStartCash.description: Positive USD cash at most 1000000000, at most 8 fractional digits.

BacktestSmaParameters.description: Semantic validation additionally requires fast < slow before job creation.

BacktestFold.description: Half-open UTC windows. Domain validation requires trainingStart < trainingEnd <= testStart < testEnd, chronologically ordered disjoint tests and at most 366 calendar days including warm-up.

BacktestRequest.description: REQ-BKT-001/006/007; T-BKT-002/011/014. Only catalog instrument IDs resolving to SPY or QQQ. Server binds every manifest reference. Semantic window and SMA ordering checks run before persistence.

barStart.description: UTC with Z and at most microsecond precision; local offsets and naive values are rejected.

BacktestManifest.description: Immutable server-bound input manifest. Revision arrays are sorted by natural identity/revisionId; decisions by knowledgeAt and outcomes by bar identity/cutoff. Run UUID and elapsed runtime excluded from hashes. A manifest may be unavailable until dataset binding completes.

completedAt.description: UTC with Z and at most microsecond precision; local offsets and naive values are rejected.

BacktestRun.description: Durable receipt returned on initial and identical replayed requests. BLOCKED/FAILED may retain completed fold references; never a run-wide return.

BacktestCursor.description: Opaque HMAC-signed keyset token, bound to resource kind, runId, result type, filters and immutable list snapshot. Malformed/signature-invalid token => 400 CURSOR_INVALID; changed context/snapshot => 409 SNAPSHOT_CONFLICT. Never client-built. Example tokens illustrate syntax only, not valid signatures.
